author: packs
description: Retail and consumer goods (X9-T1); POS, checkout, inventory and merchandising stay in the customer's systems: outlets with chains and routes, visit plans and store visits with audits and photos, in-store orders handed to the ERP, van sales with collection, trade promotions on a Ramadan and Eid calendar with claims and approval, retailer agreements and product recalls. Roles, report queries and a sidebar.
name: retail

definition.description: Visits outlets, audits shelves and takes orders.
definition.name: Field Sales Rep

definition.description: Approves promotions and claims; prices never change here.
definition.name: Trade Marketing Manager
Retail: Visit Compliance This Week
definition.sql: SELECT rep_ref, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE planned) AS planned, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE planned AND status = 'done') AS done FROM rtl_visit WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND visit_date >= date_trunc('week', NOW()) GROUP BY rep_ref

definition.name: Retail: Out of Stock Findings
definition.sql: SELECT product_ref, COUNT(*) AS outlets_out FROM rtl_store_audit WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND on_shelf = false AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY product_ref ORDER BY outlets_out DESC

definition.name: Retail: Promotion Spend vs Budget
definition.sql: SELECT id, name, season, budget, spent FROM rtl_promotion WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND status IN ('approved', 'running') ORDER BY starts_on

title: Pack: retail and consumer goods
